# `GET /changes/<node-id>[?file=<path>]`: diff text on demand

## What to build

The web page will show each node's changed files (already in the SSE snapshot as `graph.nodes[i].view.changes`) and, when a file is expanded, its diff text. Diff text is too large to push on every tick, so this slice adds a read-only HTTP route that returns it on demand, plus the git functions that produce it. `ChangeTracker` (`src/runner/changes.ts`) already knows each tracked node's `worktree` and `base` (filled from `changes:track` events; tracked nodes are task ids, `@fixer` and `@gate-fixer`). This slice adds `fileDiff(nodeId, path)` to it and passes the tracker from `src/runner/run.ts` through `UiOptions` to `createWebServer`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/web/server.ts` (lines 19–30) — `WebServerOptions` (add `changes`).
- `src/web/server.ts` (lines 55–75) — `snapshot()` builds `graphModel(...)`; `model.nodes` is a `Map<id, { title, view }>` with every node id of the run.
- `src/web/server.ts` (lines 132–163) — `retryRoute` (404 for an unknown node via `graphModel(...).nodes.has(id)`) and `handle`: Host check (421), Origin check for POST (403), prefix routing for `/retry/`. Mirror this for `GET /changes/`.
- `src/web/start.ts` — `startWebUi(opts)` creates the server; pass `opts.changes` through.
- `src/ui/start.tsx` (lines 9–39) — `UiOptions` (add `changes?`).
- `src/runner/run.ts` — `execute()` creates `const changes = new ChangeTracker(events)` and later calls `opts.ui?.({ events, layers, ... })`: add `changes` there.
- `src/runner/changes.ts` — `ChangeTracker` and its per-node `{ worktree, base, exclude }` map.
- `src/git/git.ts` — `worktreeChanges` (how untracked/binary files are detected) and the `git()` helper.
- `src/web/server.test.ts` (lines 1–63, 163–227) — `setup()`, `rawRequest`, and the `POST /retry/:id` tests to mirror.

## Patterns to follow

**JSON responses**: `json(res, status, body)` in `server.ts`.

**Prefix route** — like `/retry/`:
```ts
if (req.method === "POST" && pathname.startsWith("/retry/")) { let id; try { id = decodeURIComponent(...) } catch { return void json(res, 404, ...) } ... }
```

**git** — every call starts with `--no-optional-locks`; never write to the index or the worktree.

## Shapes (exact)

```ts
// src/runner/changes.ts
export interface FileDiff {
  path: string;
  /** Unified diff text, possibly cut at DIFF_CAP_BYTES. */
  diff: string;
  truncated: boolean;
  binary: boolean;
}
export const DIFF_CAP_BYTES = 200 * 1024;

// ChangeTracker
fileDiff(nodeId: string, file: string): Promise<FileDiff | undefined>; // undefined: node not tracked

// UiOptions / WebServerOptions
changes?: Pick<ChangeTracker, "fileDiff">;
```

HTTP:
- `GET /changes/<id>` → `200 { files: ChangedFile[] }` (from the store: `model.nodes.get(id).view.changes?.files ?? []`); `404 { error }` for an id not in `graphModel(...).nodes`.
- `GET /changes/<id>?file=<path>` → `200 FileDiff`; `404` unknown node; `400 { error: "unknown file" }` when `file` is not one of that node's `view.changes.files[].path` (this also rejects `..`, absolute paths, and anything else); `404` when the tracker returns `undefined`.
- Same Host guard (421) as the other routes; GET needs no Origin check.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/runner/changes.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `fileDiff(nodeId, file)`: look up the tracked entry; return `undefined` if none. Then:
  - Run `git --no-optional-locks diff --no-renames --numstat <base> -- <file>` in `worktree`. If it reports `-\t-`, return `{ path: file, diff: "", truncated: false, binary: true }`.
  - If it reports a line, run `git --no-optional-locks diff --no-renames <base> -- <file>` in `worktree` and use its stdout.
  - If it reports nothing, the file is untracked: read it, return `binary: true` if its first 8000 bytes contain `\0`, otherwise build the diff text yourself (do **not** use `git diff --no-index`, because `/dev/null` is unreliable on Windows):
    ```
    --- /dev/null
    +++ b/<file>
    @@ -0,0 +1,<n> @@
    +line1
    +line2
    ```
  - Cap: if `Buffer.byteLength(diff) > DIFF_CAP_BYTES`, cut at the last `\n` before the cap and set `truncated: true`.
  - If the worktree is gone, the git call throws: return `undefined`. A later slice adds git-history diffs for finished nodes.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE `src/ui/start.tsx`, `src/web/start.ts`, `src/web/server.ts`, `src/runner/run.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: add `changes?: Pick<ChangeTracker, "fileDiff">` to `UiOptions` and `WebServerOptions` (type-only import of `ChangeTracker`), pass `changes: opts.changes` in `startWebUi`, and pass `changes` in the `opts.ui?.({...})` call in `run.ts`.
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `handle`, before the `routes` lookup: `if (req.method === "GET" && pathname.startsWith("/changes/")) return void (await changesRoute(...))`, with `changesRoute` decoding the id (404 on a decode error), reading `file` from `new URL(req.url, "http://localhost").searchParams.get("file")`, and following the contract above. Also make `known` (the 405 check) recognize `/changes/` like `/retry/`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### UPDATE `src/web/server.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** `describe("GET /changes/:id")`: build the server with a fake `changes: { fileDiff: async (id, f) => ({ path: f, diff: "+x\n", truncated: false, binary: false }) }`; emit `nodeChanges` for task `a` with one file `src/x.ts`. Assert:
  - `/changes/a` → 200 with that file;
  - `/changes/zzz` → 404;
  - `/changes/a?file=src/x.ts` → 200 with the fake diff;
  - `/changes/a?file=../../etc/passwd` → 400;
  - `/changes/a?file=other.ts` → 400;
  - a foreign Host → 421.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/server.test.ts`

### UPDATE `src/runner/changes.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: tests for `fileDiff` on a temp repo (`tempRepo()` from `src/__fixtures__/repo.ts`): a modified tracked file gives a unified diff containing `+` lines; an untracked file gives the `/dev/null` header and `+` lines; a binary file gives `binary: true`; a file over 200 KB gives `truncated: true` and a diff of at most `DIFF_CAP_BYTES` bytes; an untracked node gives `undefined`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/runner/changes.test.ts`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /changes/<id>` lists the node's changed files; an unknown id returns 404.
- [ ] `GET /changes/<id>?file=<path>` returns the diff text for tracked, untracked and binary files; over 200 KB it is truncated with `truncated: true`.
- [ ] A `file` not in the node's change list (including traversal attempts) returns 400; the server never reads a path built from user input that isn't in that list.
- [ ] Host guard applies (421).
- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` pass.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npx vitest run src/web/server.test.ts src/runner/changes.test.ts
npm test
```
